KILLJOY is no longer in active development. Thank you all for your support.

KILLJOY: INFECTION is a fast-paced zombie survival game where teamwork is key.

The year is 2022.
A deadly virus, known as the Olympus Virus, has escaped containment after a BDC bio-lab was breached. 

Originating from Martian fungus samples, it has spread rapidly across the East Coast of the Robloxian States, turning the infected into grotesque, mindless killers.

Society is on the brink of collapse—survival is the only option.

Welcome to Dinosaur Arcade! Return to the Mesozoic Era and experience the world as your favorite dinosaur, visualized in an arcade style aesthetic! Search the map for fossil deposits to research new dinosaurs, investigate meteor impact sites, and uncover the secrets of the mayhem!

🎮 PC/XBOX Controls
[Left-Click], [RT] - Interact

[Shift], [LT] - Sprint

[R], [DPadUp] - Roar
[Z], [DPadDown]  - Rest

[U], [X] - Hide GUI
[H], [DPadLeft] - Change camera view
[Space], [A] - Jump
